title: Controlled Goods assessment reporting needs a protected review and receipt trail
remediation: The sponsor registration owner and designated official determine reporting applicability and approve custody, review and reconciliation responsibilities. Verify a sampled reporting period against a protected assessment register, review approval and any existing submission receipt. Record missing evidence as pending. Exclude personal fields and report contents from the general assessor export.

milestones.title: Collect a redacted reporting period review, approval and existing receipt reference, or the signed pending-scope decision
